description: Progression planning — Washington as primary objective, varied starting points

requests.notes: Vary the starting point and framing: runner with no hiking background, family wanting to do Washington together, someone who did a few easy hikes last summer. Always include a logical ordered progression toward Washington.
Hiker has done some 4K footers already. Vary objectives: working toward Washington winter route, completing the full 48, planning a Presidential traverse day
Build-up hikes only — no 4K footers required. Hiker wants to work up to their first 4K footer, not Washington specifically. Use easier trails as the scaffolding.
